from collections import Counter

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flat); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # candidate line color: most common non-fill
    linec=None
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if c!=fill and n>W*H*0.1: linec=c; break
    hidx=[r for r in range(H) if np.mean(g[r]==linec)>0.7]
    vidx=[c for c in range(W) if np.mean(g[:,c]==linec)>0.7]

    vidx=[c for c in vidx if c not in (0,W-1)]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hidx)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vidx)-1):
            corners=[g[hidx[k],vidx[l]] for k in (i,i+1) for l in (j,j+1)]
            ok=all(c!=linec for c in corners) and len(set(corners))==1
            row.append(corners[0] if ok else fill)
